svg.title: Contribution world · a year drawn as a skyline
svg.desc: 113 contributions over 22 active days from Oct 26, 2025 to Oct 31, 2026. Peak day: 19 on Sep 28, 2026. Busiest weekday: Monday. Longest streak: 2 days, Nov 20–21. Momentum: minus 18% (Oct 1–31 over Sep 1–30). Tower height and colour show each day's contributions, from gold on light days to crimson on the busiest. A red moon, red clouds and a distant skyline sit on the right. Open the contribution explorer to inspect the calendar.

g.text: · tower height is the day's count
